# Copilot Instructions

- Project: Unity 6000.0.63f1 maze/puzzle adventure. Main scenes live in Assets/Scenes (MenuScene, GameScene). Scripts under Assets/Scripts.
- Core loop: MazeGenerator builds a static 3D grid from MazeSO, then MazeSO.MazeAlgorithm instantiates an IMazeGenerator (DFS, BinaryTree, Sidewinder, AldousBroder, HuntAndKill, RandomPrims, RandomKruskal, Eller). After carving, always call MazeGenerator.Instance.CreateExitPaths to open fixed-axis exits.
- Maze configuration: MazeSO ScriptableObjects (Resources/Scriptable/MazeLevel/*) hold dimensions, prefabs, and chosen algorithm; cell size comes from the first child renderer of CellMap. MazeGenerator.CreateGrid spawns Cell prefabs and caches MazeGrid/KeyPoint singletons for algorithms to mutate.
- Algorithm pattern: Constructors receive MazeSO + cellSize, pull MazeGenerator.MazeGrid and MazeGenerator.KeyPoint, carve using MazeTools helpers (GetUnvisitedNeighbor, RemoveWallsBetween, dynamic axes). Place puzzles via MazeTools.PlacePuzzle using PuzzleGenerator prefabs keyed by MazeAlgorithmType.
- Utility axes: MazeTools.IdentifyDynamicAxes enforces two varying axes (e.g., XZ mazes). Use MazeTools.GetValidDirections/GetCellByAxes instead of hardcoding directions; they respect the active dynamic axes.
- Pathfinding: PathFinding_Astar runs over MazeGenerator.MazeGrid honoring walls; see Assets/Scripts/Algorithm/PathFinding_Astar.cs for neighbor checks and Manhattan heuristic.
- Player & input: CharacterMovement uses CharacterController, Cinemachine camera, and InputManager (PlayerInput actions Move/Look/Run/Interact/Map/Bag/OpenMouse/OpenDebug/OpenPause/ClosePause). Movement stops if MouseLock reports the mouse is free.
- Persistence: Implement IGameData (LoadData/SaveData) to auto-participate in save/load. GameDataManager discovers all IGameData on scene load, loads from Application.persistentDataPath/SettingConf/<fileName>, and saves on scene unload/quit via FileDataHandler (optional XOR encryption).
- Game flow: GameManager spawns player/goal from MazeGrid corners, tracks current cell for minimap/fog, formats time, and levels up through LevelUpgrade (resets maze, reloads SceneLoadManager loading screen). PoolClone holds puzzle instances to toggle instead of destroying.
- Puzzles: PuzzleGenerator maps MazeAlgorithmType to prefab lists; MazeTools.PlacePuzzle instantiates into the maze. PuzzleManager switches cameras and activates boards for TileSwap, PairPath, and Wordle puzzles. PuzzleBoardBase handles puzzle state, notifications, and persistence via unique IDs stored in GameData.puzzleStates.
- UI & cameras: MiniMapCamera/MapCamera and FogOfWarMask are driven by GameManager; resizing/minimap reveal relies on MazeSO dimensions and MazeTools.GetCellFromGameObject for cell lookup.
- Conventions: Singletons everywhere (`Instance` static property); most managers `Destroy(this)` on duplicate in Awake. Resources folder is used to auto-wire PlayerSO, MazeSO per level, and prefabs (CellMap, Ending). Avoid manual wiring if a Reset() already loads from Resources.
- Extending algorithms: Implement IMazeGenerator.GenerateMazeInstant, use MazeGenerator.MazeGrid and MazeTools, add type to MazeAlgorithmType enum, and wire it in MazeSO.CreateGenerator switch so ScriptableObjects can select it.
- Extending save data: Add fields to GameData, then update relevant IGameData implementers to read/write. FileDataHandler serializes with JsonUtility; keep fields serializable.
- Input tips: InputManager lives at DefaultExecutionOrder -200; access via InputManager.Instance. Switch action maps through InputManager.InputPlayer.SwitchCurrentActionMap("UI"/"Player") or GameManager.SwitchOn/Off helpers.
- Building/running: Open the solution in Unity 6000.0.63f1, load MenuScene for entry. Play mode expects GameDataManager, MazeGenerator, PuzzleGenerator, and GameManager present in the scene hierarchy before generation.
- Debugging mazes: Use MazeGenerator.ResetGrid/CreateGrid before rerunning MazeSO.Generate to avoid stale grid state. Call MazeTools.ColorPath to visualize paths using A*.
- External deps: Uses Unity Input System (PlayerInput), Cinemachine, JsonUtility; no custom editor tooling needed.
- Style: Keep comments concise; preserve existing localized strings in MazeTools (Vietnamese log messages). Prefer using MazeTools helpers over ad-hoc coordinate math to honor dynamic axes rules.
